summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. A returns order drives a returns delivery, an inbound receipt, an inspection whose outcome selects the follow-up activity, and a credit memo.

standard_process_flow.name: Create returns order
standard_process_flow.description: The returns order is created with reference to the preceding sales document.

evidence.quote: The returns order is created with reference to the original sales document and triggers the returns delivery.

standard_process_flow.name: Returns delivery and inbound receipt
standard_process_flow.description: Returned products are received against an inbound delivery.

evidence.quote: Returned products are received against an inbound delivery and put away or moved to a scrapping area.

standard_process_flow.name: Inspection and follow-up activity
standard_process_flow.description: The inspection result determines the follow-up activity. The delivery tolerance is also checked at this point.

evidence.quote: The inspection result determines the follow-up activity for the returned material.

standard_process_flow.name: Credit memo
standard_process_flow.description: A credit memo settles the confirmed return with the customer.
